using JSON3, Random, CUDA, JACC
function solver_cpu(x, y, tol, n)
    for i1 = 1:n
        r1 = x[i1]
        while r1 > tol
            r1 = 0.5 * r1
        end
        y[i1] = r1
    end
    return nothing
end
function solver_kern(x, y, tol, n)
    i1 = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
    if i1 > n; return nothing; end
    r1 = x[i1]
    while r1 > tol
        r1 = 0.5 * r1
    end
    y[i1] = r1
    return nothing
end
function solver_cuda(x, y, tol, n)
    @cuda threads=256 blocks=cld(n, 256) solver_kern(x, y, tol, n)
    return nothing
end
function solver_host_on_device(x, y, tol, n)   # what STADE emits today: the loop on the host, device scalars read one by one
    CUDA.@allowscalar for i1 = 1:n
        r1 = x[i1]
        while r1 > tol
            r1 = 0.5 * r1
        end
        y[i1] = r1
    end
    return nothing
end
function solver_jfun(i1, x, y, tol)
    r1 = x[i1]
    while r1 > tol
        r1 = 0.5 * r1
    end
    y[i1] = r1
    return nothing
end
solver_jacc(x, y, tol, n) = (n > 0 && JACC.parallel_for(n, solver_jfun, x, y, tol); nothing)
function best(f, k)
    f(); CUDA.synchronize()
    t = Inf
    for _ in 1:k
        t = min(t, @elapsed (f(); CUDA.synchronize()))
    end
    return t
end
gen(rng, kind, n) = kind == "uniform" ? 0.5 .+ rand(rng, n) :                                   # ~20 halvings each
                    kind == "logspread" ? exp.(rand(rng, n) .* 60 .- 15) :                      # 0 to ~60 halvings
                    kind == "mixed" ? [rand(rng) < 0.9 ? 1e-12 : 2.0^40 for _ in 1:n] : nothing  # 90% zero trips, 10% ~60
out = Any[]
tol = 1e-6
for kind in ("uniform", "logspread", "mixed"), n in (2000, 100000, 1000000)
    rng = MersenneTwister(11)
    x = gen(rng, kind, n); yc = zeros(n)
    tcpu = best(() -> solver_cpu(x, yc, tol, n), 3)
    xd = CUDA.CuArray(x); yd = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); xj = JACC.array(x); yj = JACC.zeros(Float64, n)
    row = Dict{String,Any}("kind" => kind, "n" => n, "cpu_native_s" => tcpu)
    try row["cuda_s"] = best(() -> solver_cuda(xd, yd, tol, n), 5); row["cuda_ok"] = Array(yd) == yc catch e; row["cuda_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200) end
    try row["jacc_s"] = best(() -> solver_jacc(xj, yj, tol, n), 5); row["jacc_ok"] = Array(yj) == yc; row["jacc_type"] = string(typeof(yj)) catch e; row["jacc_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200) end
    if n <= 100000
        try ys = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); row["host_on_device_s"] = best(() -> solver_host_on_device(xd, ys, tol, n), 1); row["host_ok"] = Array(ys) == yc catch e; row["host_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200) end
    end
    push!(out, row)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("results" => out)))
